title: MI Query Agent — Stage 2: the model proposes a concept, the registry binds the field
stage: 2 of 4. Deterministic proof only — NO model call was made.

no_model_was_called.why: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not in this environment, and standing rule 12 forbids accepting a key by any other route.
no_model_was_called.what_that_costs: the PROMPT has not been exercised against a live model. Everything else in this stage is a property of the binder, which holds whatever the model says — that is the point of putting the binding on the other side of it — and all of it is measured here.
no_model_was_called.what_stage_4_still_needs: a key in the environment, and the invocation count taken from SUCCESSFUL RESPONSES, not attempts.

part_a_the_model_list.the_defect: _NO_SAMPLING_MODELS listed seven model-name fragments, and temperature=0.0 was sent to every model that did not match. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 — THE REPOSITORY DEFAULT — is not on it, and neither is claude-opus-5.
part_a_the_model_list.demonstrated_before_the_fix: with a fake client and no API credit: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 and claude-opus-5 both raise TypeError before any HTTP request; claude-opus-4-8 succeeds.
part_a_the_model_list.why_the_list_was_the_wrong_shape: it encoded a MODEL property when the binding constraint here is an SDK property. anthropic 1.1.0's messages.create has no temperature, top_p or top_k parameter at all — verified against the installed signature — so on that SDK no model accepts them whatever its name. A list keyed on the model could not have been right for any model.

the_mechanism.fact_1: does this SDK expose the parameter — asked of the signature, not assumed from a version string. An SDK taking arbitrary **kwargs reports them acceptable and defers, because it cannot know what the API allows.
the_mechanism.fact_2: does this model accept it — only the API can answer, learned from the rejection and remembered, so a model release costs one retry rather than a source edit.
the_mechanism.and_the_failure_is_caught_where_it_happe: the old code sent the sampling kwargs on BOTH the cached and the uncached attempt and caught neither on the path that mattered. A TypeError from the SDK and a 400 from the API are one fact told two ways; both downgrade once. 529, 401 and a missing argument still raise.

measured_after.installed SDK, no temperature parameter: all four models reach the call with no sampling kwarg (two of them previously raised)
measured_after.SDK exposing temperature, model rejects: downgrades once, remembers, and the next call sends nothing

part_a_the_model_list.the_test_asserted_the_defect: test_temperature_gated_for_models_that_reject_it read _supports_temperature('claude-haiku-4-5-20251001') is True and seven more like it, and all eight passed throughout the void run. A rater whose list overlaps the decision under change can only confirm that the list says what the list says. Replaced with seven tests of the MECHANISM.

part_b_concept_proposal.the_constraint: the model proposes a concept in registered vocabulary. It never names a governed field, a spec, a route or a plan. The registry binds.

what_actually_protects_the_binding.finding: THE KIND DOES, NOT THE REGISTRY. This contradicts the brief's premise. `erm_sub_product_type` IS a registered dimension on this registry, and `_explicit_dimensions('erm sub product type', semantics, available_columns=<the tape's columns>)` binds to it TODAY — measured, with the availability filter passed. So 'the registry turns lump sum into erm_product_type' is not by itself sufficient: a registry handed that phrase would produce exactly the field the Opus run got wrong.
what_actually_protects_the_binding.what_is_sufficient: a proposal carries a KIND and each kind has ONE owner. A `category_value` proposal is asked of the book's value catalogue and of nothing else, so `lump sum` reaches `erm_product_type` and cannot reach any dimension field however it is spelled. Dataset availability closes the rest: the vocabulary is scoped to the BOOK, so `erm_sub_product_type` is never offered, and the binder asserts availability rather than trusting the owner.

must_not_be_proposable.why: a registered dimension this tape does not carry
one character from a governed value, and a different thing

ambiguity_report.note_within: `direct` is a value of BOTH origination_channel and source_portfolio_type. Rejected as ambiguous, never resolved by preference — that is the registry's to fix and must not be handed back to the model. As a source_book, `direct` is one thing and binds.
ambiguity_report.note_across: five terms are claimed by two kinds. The kind separates them so binding is unambiguous, but a model proposing the wrong kind gets a wrong binding that looks entirely valid. Reported so the estate can count them.

a_defect_the_census_found_in_this_stages.what: two terms were offered and did not bind: `interest rate buckets` (in the registry's synonym map, unrecognised by _explicit_dimensions) and `portfolio type (source)` (a registered business name whose parentheses the same owner does not match).
a_defect_the_census_found_in_this_stages.why_it_matters: a term the model is invited to use and then rejected for using is a trap, and the rejection reads as the model's fault.
a_defect_the_census_found_in_this_stages.fixed_as_a_class: candidates are run through the binder when the vocabulary is built. A term the owner will not bind is WITHHELD and recorded — never silently dropped, because the disagreement between the registry's synonym map and the question-shaped owner is a finding about the registry.

part_b_concept_proposal.rejection_never_nearest_match: an unregistered concept is rejected and named. `lump summ` is one character from a governed value and binds to nothing. Substituting the nearest member is invisible to every consumer downstream, which is the failure mode this programme exists to remove.
part_b_concept_proposal.normalisation: _detect_metric answers current_loan_to_value for 'ltv' and None for 'LTV'. Every serving-path caller lowercases first, so the trap has never fired there; a term-shaped binder walks straight into it. Case, spacing and underscores are normalised before any owner is asked.

stop_conditions_checked.the model must emit a governed field key: NOT FIRED. 0 raw field keys are offered as proposable terms, and a proposal whose kind is not one of the five is rejected.
stop_conditions_checked.any stage exceeds 3x its registered line: not fired; concept_proposal.py is 380 lines including its docstrings.

assurance.mi_regression: 278 modules, 85 failing names — IDENTICAL to the frozen baseline, twice (after Part A and after Part B).
assurance.unit_tests: 25 concept-proposal + 7 sampling-mechanism, all passing; 664 passed across question_interpretation with the single pre-existing frozen-baseline failure

accept a term the vocabulary does not offer -> 2 tests fail
resolve an ambiguous value by preference -> 1 test fails (GREEN until the second line of defence was tested on its own; the gap was closed, not reported)
stop normalising case and spacing -> 4 tests fail
swallow a malformed reply -> 1 test fails
